div.div: §1.1 BASELINE-FIRST GATE — a custom table / scoped app / state extension / new group requires an explicit, separate user approval. Self-authorization is prohibited; otherwise HALT and produce no artefact.

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0B3D91, #96c1ff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
PHASE 1 — Routing-time evaluation (taxonomy §6.1)
1 Restate the task in one sentence
2 Read engagement state (clients//...)
3 Surface assumptions & OPEN QUESTIONs
4 Evaluate §1.1 custom-object implications
5 Domain Expert GATEWAY → 5-Part Constraint Envelope
6 Resolve routing ambiguity (taxonomy.md)
7 Flag §3.1 routing-time consults
8–9 Propose the specialist + await approval
10 Dispatch via Task tool with the Envelope

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(28, 126, 214), rgb(70, 154, 230));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 528px; height: 1px; padding-top: 336px; margin-left: 580px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0B3D91;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0B3D91, #96c1ff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
PHASE 2 — Post-build evaluation (taxonomy §6.2)
1 Hold the artefact — do not present yet
2 Classify content (code / flow / config / design)
3 Scan for §1.1 violations (new table/scope/state)
4 Domain Expert RE-FIRES in review mode
5 Post-build consults: Code Reviewer · ATF · Op Docs · Diagramming
6–7 Present artefact + consult proposals; await decisions
8 Adopt Code Reviewer (main thread); run 4 checklists
9 On REWORK → re-dispatch the originating builder
